method: Standalone source run with verilator --binary, iverilog -g2012 -s Top / vvp -n, and xezim -s Top.
standard: IEEE 1800-2023 6.16: a single character of a string variable is of type byte; 6.11: byte is signed; 6.16.3: getc returns byte.

observations.note: The shared case also calls getc, which Icarus does not implement (sv_icarus_string_methods).
